title: Pixel art, high resolution
description: Large, detailed pixel art with fine shading and lighting, still built on a strict pixel grid.

art_style.outline_policy: Selective outline: dark on shadowed edges, none or light on lit edges.
art_style.shading_policy: Many tones per material built from pixel clusters, with a clear light direction and bounce light.
art_style.texture_policy: Fine material detail drawn pixel by pixel.
art_style.pixel_density: One art pixel is one game pixel; tiles 32 to 64 px, characters 48 to 128 px tall.
art_style.palette_reference: A fixed palette of at most 128 colours, chosen once for the whole game.

native_size_guidance: Draw at the final pixel size: tiles of 32, 48 or 64 px. Never draw large and shrink.
avoid: Do not use anti-aliasing, blur or soft gradients.
Do not draw detail finer than one art pixel.
Do not mix pixel sizes: every art pixel is the same size across the whole image.
Do not add colours outside the fixed palette of 128.
Do not use smooth gradients; build shading from pixel clusters.
